sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27:1
items.html: Practical commandments returned them to face to face: This means that through the good deeds he performed, he cleaved more to holiness, and it was within his power to make sortings of the sparks and vessels that had fallen into BYA, and to purify them of the dross in them, that is, of the admixture of phase four in them (as above, page 486 in the Inner Light, the passage beginning “the dross”; study it there well). And then he raised them as MAN [female waters] to the Nukva. And since these sparks and vessels that he raised came from the seven kings of Nekudim, in which there had already been the light of Hochma before they were broken, and since they are also parts of the Nukva, therefore the Nukva of ZA feels their lack of the light of Hochma, and because of this she ceases her posterior and turns her face toward ZA and couples face to face.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27:2
items.html: And then there was no fear of the shells, for he had already dug and hoed and cleared the stones and cut the thorns from the vineyard: That is to say, that after he had sorted the sparks and the vessels from all the dross in them — which is called the work of the vineyard, namely digging and hoeing, etc. — they are fit to rise as MAN [female waters] to the Nukva and to cause there a coupling face to face with ZA. Then these vessels are corrected as GAR [first three], and there is no longer any fear that they will be broken, as happened to these very vessels at first, in the world of Nekudim, because the thorns have already been finished off from the vineyard, which are the dross in them, as above. And from here onward they remain in holiness eternally.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27:3
items.html: One wall for the two of them, and one wall alone suffices between them, and they use a single wall: A wall means the posterior, namely the posterior of Ima, with which they are corrected in the state of back to back, which suffices for both of them as though it were the illumination of GAR [first three], as above; for it completes the lack of Hochma in them, and therefore they are protected from the externals. And this is what he says, that one wall alone suffices between them — meaning that it suffices for them to cover and conceal the lack of Hochma that is in their posterior, and the shells cannot suck from there.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27:4
items.html: Half a wall for ZA and half a wall for the Nukva: That is to say, both of them are included in this posterior, in such a manner that the shells can suck neither from ZA nor from the Nukva.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:27:5
items.html: One complete posterior was completed for this one and one complete posterior for that one, and they are able to turn face to face: For through the Hassadim and Gevurot that they attain from the upper coupling of AVI [Aba ve Ima], as written below — behold, through the Hassadim the posterior of ZA is completed as GAR [first three], and through the Gevurot the posterior of the Nukva is completed in its own right with the illumination of GAR, as written further on. And then they are fit to turn face to face.
